_readme: This is the single source of truth. The resume generator and scoring engine are only allowed to reference skills/projects/experience listed here, by their exact 'id'. Never let an LLM add a skill or claim that doesn't trace back to an id in this file, see app/validate.py. Copy this file to data/profile.json and replace everything below with your own real info.

work_authorization.notes: US citizen. No sponsorship or visa restrictions.

projects.title: Example Full-Stack Web App
bullets: Built a full-stack web app with a Python/Flask backend, React frontend, and PostgreSQL database, containerized with Docker.
Deployed to AWS with CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern | Example Corp
bullets: Built and shipped an internal tool that automated a manual reporting process, saving the team several hours per week.
Wrote unit tests and participated in code review as part of a 6-person engineering team.

hard_disqualifier_rules.pattern: ITAR|export control|U\.S\. person|Department of War|deemed export
hard_disqualifier_rules.flag: Possible ITAR/export-control restriction, verify eligibility before proceeding.
Requires US citizenship/security clearance, verify this applies to you.
May require significant professional experience, verify years required against your own experience.
May require graduate enrollment, verify against your own degree status.
